question: What unacceptable consequence would follow if impurity were not individually fixed?
premises: Impurity’s obstruction is taken to be individually fixed.
If it were not so fixed, removal would affect all alike.
All conscious beings would then be liberated together.
inference: Therefore, denying individual fixation would entail simultaneous liberation of all conscious beings.
plain_english: Otherwise, there would be simultaneous liberation for all conscious beings.
